summary: Customer says they were billed 450 USD last week for an unauthorized plan and requested a refund. Customer lookup found no record for ghost@unknown-corp.example, leaving the sender unverified and with no invoice on file. Under guideline GL-BILL-01, refunds require verifying the customer record and invoice. Propose requesting invoice and account details, then escalating to a human officer.
